<!-- pr-reviewer: 69d55141066a02314f723a39589c9fceae03610e -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

**What looks good**
- `stock_page` now ends at Apply/Fit/Delete; `machine_section` / `post_section` are still reached from `setup_pages.rs:42,50`, so Machine and Post stay editable on their setup nodes.
- Nothing is left unreachable: Dark/Light/discovered files/Browse... and the colour-vision modes all live in the Theme door. The dropped "Built-in" button was a duplicate of the Dark row (`SelectTheme(Dark)`).
- Every pick queues `SelectTheme` / `SelectThemeDialog` / `SelectColorVision` (undoable); opening the door is view state only. No `sys_*` or world writes in ui (`theme_drop.rs` only reads `theme_of` / `color_vision_of`).
- Door law matches View/Machine: the other doors close `ribbon_theme_open` and it closes them; outside press closes; a missing button is reported, not a panic. No unwrap/expect/panic outside tests; provenance line present; `theme_drop.rs` is 148 lines.
- The glyph-test exemption is justified: the Theme door is a captioned list door like View (`icon_of` -> None), and the exemption is `matches!(cell, View | Theme)` only.
- Decisions file present; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #441`. Branch already contains current main (trial merge: "Already up to date").

**Local results (merged with main, CWD `crates/ui`)**
| check | result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-ui --lib` | 315 passed, 2 ignored |
| `--test operations` | 31 passed |
| `--test theme_files` | 14 passed |
| `--test egui_app` (snapshots) | 3 passed |
| `--test shell` | 20 passed |
| `clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Snapshots:** I compared the old and new `egui_app.png`: the changes are in the ribbon row only (new cell reflows it; the build-label second line is dropped by the existing narrow-width contraction). Any pixel diffs on another OS are a platform artifact.

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- In the snapshot the View group is tight: "Panels..." and "Theme..." almost touch. Consider a little padding for the group when you next touch the ribbon.
- The Browse... file dialog and the open dropdown are not covered by a GUI run (by policy).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
